stem.text: When a sample of a gas is compressed at constant temperature from $1500\ \text{kPa}$ to $6000\ \text{kPa}$, its volume changes from $76.0\ \text{cm}^{3}$ to $20.5\ \text{cm}^{3}$.
Which statements are possible explanations for this result?

items: The gas does not behave ideally.
Some of the gas is lost from the container.
